message.guildmark.trade.hunt.horn: A horn on the hill. Someone has seen your load.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.nothing: They turn out everything you carry and find nothing worth the taking.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.robbed: The party of %2$s took %1$s of your goods and ran for their camp. Bring one down before they are clear and what it carries is yours again.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.refund: A booking you can no longer fill was let go, and its deposit of %s Guild Marks given back.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.won: You beat off the party of %1$s, and the purse they carried is yours: %2$s Guild Marks.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.won_free: You beat off the party of %s.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.run_down: Run down! What they carried lies where they fell.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.driven: The party breaks off: this is too near a town for them.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.lost: You have given them the slip.
message.guildmark.trade.hunt.owed: You left before the band had its share, so it has taken it now: %s of your goods are gone.
news.guildmark.outlaw.hunt_beaten: %4$s beat off a party of %1$s, %2$s, on the road to %3$s.
news.guildmark.outlaw.hunt_beaten_wild: %4$s beat off a party of %1$s, %2$s, in %3$s.
ware.guildmark.hired_guard_1.line: A spear at your back on the road for a day
ware.guildmark.hired_guard_1.tip: One of the hall's guards walks a few steps behind you for a day of the world's clock, paid up front. In a Hunt they step in front of you, and once a blow is struck they fight the band for real; anywhere else they keep out of trouble. Each guard with you makes a band less likely to try you. Hire as many as your rung allows; a travelling companion counts as one.
ware.guildmark.hired_guard_2.line: A spear at your back on the road for two days
ware.guildmark.hired_guard_2.tip: One of the hall's guards walks a few steps behind you for two days of the world's clock, paid up front. In a Hunt they step in front of you, and once a blow is struck they fight the band for real; anywhere else they keep out of trouble. Each guard with you makes a band less likely to try you. Hire as many as your rung allows; a travelling companion counts as one.
ware.guildmark.hired_guard_3.line: A spear at your back on the road for three days
ware.guildmark.hired_guard_3.tip: One of the hall's guards walks a few steps behind you for three days of the world's clock, paid up front. In a Hunt they step in front of you, and once a blow is struck they fight the band for real; anywhere else they keep out of trouble. Each guard with you makes a band less likely to try you. Hire as many as your rung allows; a travelling companion counts as one.
gui.guildmark.trade.guard.gate.off: Guards are not for hire while the Hunt is switched off.
gui.guildmark.trade.guard.gate.full: You have all the company your rung allows.
message.guildmark.trade.guard.days_last: %s: less than an hour of hire left.
message.guildmark.trade.guard.ended: %s's hired days are over. They walk off towards the nearest town.
message.guildmark.trade.guard.ended_away: A hired guard's days are over.
message.guildmark.trade.guard.dismissed: You dismiss %s. They walk off towards the nearest town.
message.guildmark.trade.guard.dismissed_: A hired guard's contract is ended.
message.guildmark.trade.guard.fallen: %s has fallen in the fight. Their contract is ended.
message.guildmark.errand.hover_ride: %s: gone %s day(s), %s%% chance they don't come back; rides guard on a trading house's wagons, for no pay
message.guildmark.errand.back_ride: %s is back from the errand (%s), unpaid as agreed. Veteran %s now.
